# Environment variable reference

<!-- Generated by python -m tools.generate_env_reference; do not edit. -->

Defaults describe an unset environment. The declaration is the public getter contract. Effective defaults include per-engine policy and the defaults of legacy direct consumers. Automatic conditions name the policy or consumer that makes the decision. An enabled option still needs its kernel's dtype, layout and native-operator checks. Runtime routing depends on those checks.

Categories distinguish configuration, tuning, experimental, debug and deprecated controls. Prefer engine configuration and `VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS` for migrated acceleration paths.

This is the user reference. Internal tuning, diagnostics and compatibility aliases remain in the metadata inventory; they are not daily configuration options. Developers can render that inventory with `--include-internal --output /tmp/environment-internals.md`. See [SM70 environment surface](../design/sm70_environment_surface.md) for compatibility and removal plans.

| Variable | Category | Description | Declared default | Effective default | Automatic conditions / legacy consumer defaults | Acceleration paths |

| `VLLM_DEEP_GEMM_WARMUP` | configuration | DeepGemm JITs the kernels on-demand. The warmup attempts to make DeepGemm JIT all the required kernels before model execution so there is no JIT'ing in the hot-path. However, this warmup increases the engine startup time by a couple of minutes. Available options: - "skip"  : Skip warmup. - "full"  : Warmup deepgemm by running all possible gemm shapes the engine could encounter. - "relax" : Select gemm shapes to run based on some heuristics. The heuristic aims to have the same effect as running all possible gemm shapes, but provides no guarantees. | 'relax' | 'relax' | None | No SM70 path association |
